composition: Land gate with two spired towers from the park side · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Cellebroederspoort at Kampen is a brick land gate. A rectangular middle under a wolf roof sits between two towers whose lower parts are round and whose upper stages are fourteen-sided, each with a tall spire. It is overcast, about 12.1°C, with wind near 7.2 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. The carved lions and the year are not readable. The Koornmarktspoort is the river gate and is not this frame.
